meta.note: Mockup values only. Real data comes from the project repo.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, panels. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table headers, empty states, map counties with no cases. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: DECORATIVE dividers only (table rows, card edges). Never the only edge of a control: 1.5:1 / 1.8:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, buttons, chips, map county outlines, chart axes. 4.4:1+ on bg, surface and sunken in both themes (needs 3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and chart mark outlines on bg, surface, sunken, info-bg, caution-bg (13:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table meta on bg, surface, sunken (6.8:1+). Not for disabled controls.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, selected states on bg and surface (7.7:1+).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button; hovered link text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (8.4:1 light, 9.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (3px solid, 2px offset) on bg, surface and sunken: 4.5:1+ light, 10:1+ dark. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the scope (info) notice. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Border and icon of the scope (info) notice (7.7:1+ on bg).

tokens.name: caution-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the "not pooled, not final" notice. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: caution-border
tokens.usage: Border and icon of the caution notice (5.8:1+ on bg).

tokens.name: synth-bg
tokens.usage: Synthetic-data banner fill, identical in both themes so it is never missed. Text on it: synth-ink (13:1+).

tokens.name: synth-ink
tokens.usage: Text, icons and hazard stripes on synth-bg.

tokens.name: approve-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the "Approved" outcome chip. Text: approve-ink.

tokens.name: approve-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the "Approved" chip on approve-bg (9:1+).

tokens.name: approve-border
tokens.usage: Border of the "Approved" chip (3:1+ on bg and on approve-bg). Blue side of the blue/orange outcome pair.

tokens.name: deny-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the "Denied" outcome chip. Text: deny-ink.

tokens.name: deny-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the "Denied" chip on deny-bg (8.7:1+).

tokens.name: deny-border
tokens.usage: Border of the "Denied" chip (4.5:1+). Orange side of the blue/orange outcome pair, safe for red-green colour blindness.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Map class 1: 1 case. Lightest in light theme, darkest in dark theme (more cases = more contrast with the page in both).

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Map class 2: 2 cases.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Map class 3: 3–4 cases.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Map class 4: 5–9 cases.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Map class 5: 10 or more cases.

tokens.name: seq-1-ink
tokens.usage: County count labels on seq-1 (11:1 light, 9.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: seq-2-ink
tokens.usage: County count labels on seq-2 (9.4:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: seq-3-ink
tokens.usage: County count labels on seq-3 (6.8:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: seq-4-ink
tokens.usage: County count labels on seq-4 (5.1:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: seq-5-ink
tokens.usage: County count labels on seq-5 (12.8:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: map-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of every county (0.75px). Gives each shape a 4.9:1 / 6:1 edge against the page, so no county depends on its fill for visibility.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Category 1: No local authority for the use. Always drawn with a cat-outline stroke and the circle glyph.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Category 2: State farmland standards. Square glyph.

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Category 3: Goal exception criteria. Triangle glyph.

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Category 4: Neighbor farm impacts. Diamond glyph.

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Category 5: Visual and tourism impacts. Inverted-triangle glyph.

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Category 6: Farmland loss. Hexagon glyph.

tokens.name: cat-7
tokens.usage: Category 7: Inadequate findings. Plus glyph.

tokens.name: cat-8
tokens.usage: Category 8: Other (uncoded). Ring glyph. Neutral on purpose: "uncoded" is not a topic.

tokens.name: cat-outline
tokens.usage: Stroke (1.5px) around every category mark. It carries the 3:1 edge, because cat-4, cat-5 and cat-7 fills are under 3:1 against surface.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.serif: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, "Book Antiqua", Georgia, serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, once per page. 30px / 36px under 640px container width.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: This site shows the reasons given for approving or denying solar permits on Oregon farmland.
styles.usage: Scope statement and region introductions. Max 68ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Counts are not pooled across source types.
styles.usage: Default text. 16px is the floor for running text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, table headers, legend items. 14px is the smallest size on the site.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The one big number on Overview and county panels. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding block; list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, card padding, paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions on phones.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a page region on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, table wrappers, notice corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Segmented switch only.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every interactive control (WCAG 2.2 asks for 24px; we use 44px).

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between control and focus ring so the ring always sits on the page ground.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for running text.

tokens.name: mark-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of chart marks and legend swatches.

tokens.name: map-stroke-width
tokens.usage: County outline weight (3px for the selected county).
